subject: Issue with model building in Linux terminal

messages.author: 82dca711d8bdf874
messages.subject: Issue with model building in Linux terminal
parts:
Hi folks,

I've been using nimble on a Linux machine mostly through RStudio. Recently, I've wanted to run nimble through the terminal using the Rscript command to decrease my total RAM usage for a particularly large model. When I run this particular script through Rstudio it builds a nimble model object with no issues, but I get this feedback when running it through the Rscript command in the Linux terminal:

Loading required package: nimble

Attaching package: ‘nimble’

The following object is masked from ‘package:stats’:

    simulate

The following object is masked from ‘package:base’:

    deparse

defining model...
building model...
Error in newClass(inputList = inputList, name = name) : 
  could not find function "new"
Calls: nimbleModel -> BUGSmodel -> <Anonymous> -> modelClass -> newClass
Execution halted

I can't seem to find any information on this error. Does anybody know what the issue is and if there is a fix available?

Thanks very much. Cheers,

Evan Adams, PhD
Ecological Modeler

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Issue with model building in Linux terminal
parts:
Evan, I think this is occurring because the methods package is loaded
automatically in an interactive session but not with Rscript. Try
"library(methods)" at the beginning of your script.

Chris

messages.author: 2226e6c311219eb7
messages.subject: Re: Issue with model building in Linux terminal
parts:
Hi Evan

I have a suspicion about what is going on, but it would help to see the output from sessionInfo().

A quick thing to try is adding

library(methods)

to your script.

Rscript doesn't, by default, attach the methods package to the search path.


D.
